changesMenu.lastWorkspace: The last working directory cannot be unlinked.
changesMenu.deleteDescription: Delete this worktree from disk and unlink it from the task. The task and branch are kept. Uncommitted changes and files in this directory will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

context.detachDescription: Only removes this task's association. Files, worktrees, branches and external issues / PRs are kept.
context.changed: Content changed in another view or by an Agent. Keep your draft and reopen the latest content before trying again.
context.workspaceBusy: Stop sessions, terminals or initialization commands using this workspace first.
context.restoreSession: Archived {{date}} · Click to restore without starting
context.snapshot: This session only has a startup snapshot. Restart to connect live context where the CLI supports it.
context.file: The context file updates with task changes. The Agent is instructed to reread it each turn; reading is not guaranteed. Click to copy a reminder for the existing terminal.
context.fileFailed: Context file sync failed; the Agent may read stale content. Click to retry and copy a reading reminder.
context.reminderCopied: Reading reminder copied. Paste it into the CLI's conversation input.
context.reminderFailed: Could not update or copy the context reminder. Please retry.
context.retryHint: Successful commands are skipped. Failed or interrupted scripts may have partially executed.
context.setupBlocked: Complete worktree initialization before starting an Agent.

branch.title: Branch and changes
branch.failed: Unable to read changes. Check the working directory and retry.
branch.untracked_one: {{count}} untracked file is excluded, matching the full Diff.
branch.untracked_other: {{count}} untracked files are excluded, matching the full Diff.
branch.baseUnavailable: The source branch is missing or has no comparable commits. Working tree changes are still available.

archival.title: Archive task?
archival.description: Stops agents for “{{title}}” and keeps the task, session history, notes and attachments. You can restore the task later.
archival.cleanupWarning: Task terminals will close before cleanup. Restoring the task will not recover deleted worktrees or branches.
archival.changed: Resources changed. Review the updated checklist and confirm archiving again.
archival.confirmation: Archive confirmation expired. Review the updated checklist and confirm again.
archival.inspection: Safety checks failed. Retry, or turn off cleanup to archive the task without removing files.
archival.failed: Archiving did not finish. The task and history were kept and agents were stopped. Check the cleanup scope and try again.

deletion.description: Stops sessions and terminals for “{{title}}”, then removes the task, session records, associations and managed attachment copies.
deletion.keepByDefault: Worktrees and branches are kept unless selected below.
deletion.keepExisting: Existing working directories and branches will be kept.
deletion.ignored_one: {{count}} Git-ignored file will also be deleted.
deletion.ignored_other: {{count}} Git-ignored files will also be deleted.
deletion.detached: Detached HEAD — commits may become unreachable after deletion.
deletion.clean: No uncommitted or ignored files found.
deletion.unpublished: Push status is unknown. Deleting the branch may lose local commits.
deletion.pushed: Local branch will be deleted; no unique commits found against local remote-tracking refs.
deletion.unpushed_one: Local branch will be deleted; {{count}} commit is absent from known remote refs and may be lost.
deletion.unpushed_other: Local branch will be deleted; {{count}} commits are absent from known remote refs and may be lost.
deletion.localRefs: Commit checks use local remote-tracking refs only, without contacting remotes. Remote branches are never deleted.

reasons.existing: Existing workspace — directory and branch are kept.
reasons.unowned: Cannot verify task ownership of this worktree; kept.
reasons.shared: Still used by other tasks; kept.
reasons.changed: Resource identity or branch changed; kept.
reasons.missing: Resource is already missing; no further cleanup.
reasons.inUse: Branch is used by another worktree or task; kept.
reasons.inspectionFailed: Cannot fully inspect this resource. Retry or turn off cleanup.

errors.changed: Resources changed. Review the updated checklist and confirm again.
errors.confirmation: Deletion confirmation expired. Review the updated checklist and confirm again.
errors.inspection: Safety checks failed. Retry, or turn off cleanup to delete only the task.
errors.failed: Deletion did not finish. The task was kept; completed cleanup cannot be undone. Review and retry, or turn off cleanup to keep remaining resources.

actions.refreshWorkspaceFailed: Some working directories failed to refresh
actions.copyFailedHint: Could not write to the clipboard. Please try again.

dialogs.renameDescription: Only changes the task title, not its description or branch.
dialogs.deleteDescription: Deletes the task and attachment copies. Original files, repos, branches and worktrees are kept.

recovery.retainedDirectories: A previous task creation did not finish. These working directories were retained for inspection.

feedback.createdHidden: Task created, but hidden by the current filters.

errors.invalid: Invalid task. Check the description and selected resources.
errors.invalidTitle: Enter a task title up to 160 characters.
errors.notFound: This task was removed. Refresh the list.
errors.busy: A task operation is in progress. Try again shortly.
errors.legacyInvalid: Legacy task data is invalid and has not been overwritten. Repair it and retry.

workspaceOpen.failedDetail: Check that the working directory, remote URL, or selected application is still available.

notes.title: Task notes
notes.copyFailed: Could not copy note. Please try again.
notes.deleteDescription: “{{title}}” will be deleted from this task, including any unsaved changes. This cannot be undone.
notes.discardDescription: This note has unsaved changes. They will be lost if you leave.
notes.notFound: This note has been deleted. Please select another note.

resources.title: Add resources
resources.fileDescription: Choose a single file on disk to bind to this task by its original path. The file is never copied or modified.
resources.alreadyLinked: This resource is already linked to this task.

runtime.allWorktreesDescription: Runs in the task folder with context for all linked directories
runtime.resumeUnavailable: A resumable native conversation has not been identified yet. Start a new session for other work.
runtime.restartUnavailable: A resumable native conversation has not been identified yet. Start a new session for other work.
runtime.startFailed: Unable to start or continue the session. Check the CLI, login, working directory and terminal output, then retry.
runtime.modeUnsupported: This CLI cannot apply the selected mode at startup. Create a session with a supported mode instead.
runtime.optionUnsupported: This installed CLI does not support a selected launch option. Update the CLI or choose another configuration.
runtime.resourceErrorDetail: The resource may be missing or unavailable. Check its location and try again.
runtime.renameNativeDescription: The session will stop before its native CLI name is updated. No task prompt is resent; you can resume it afterwards.
runtime.deleteNativeDescription: Stop and permanently delete the native CLI history and Navo record for “{{name}}”. The task, repositories and working directories are kept. This cannot be undone.
runtime.nativeActionsUnavailable: Reliable native session management is not available for this agent yet.
runtime.nativeActionFailed: The native CLI operation failed. The Navo record is kept. Check the CLI, file permissions, or retry later.

taskLink.missing: This task was not found on this device. It may have been deleted or belong to another device.
taskLink.failed: Could not open the task link. Please open the link again.
